name: pi-vibeguard
notes: Forked from aizigao/pi-vibeguard (npm @aizigao/pi-vibeguard v0.1.2). Local divergence per openspec change add-vibeguard-mapping-command: (1) npm renamed to @xzzpig/pi-vibeguard, fork version 0.1.0 (now 0.2.0), repository field repointed to xzzpig/pi-extensions; (2) added peerDependency @earendil-works/pi-tui (range aligned with pi-tool-display) plus vitest devDep for the new tests; (3) Mapping View section (parseCategoryFromPlaceholder/maskOriginal/buildMappingSnapshot/buildCategoryStats/formatTtlRemaining + MappingViewModal) lives in fork-only mapping-view.ts and category-picker.ts (CategoryPickerModal) since 2026-09-19; index.ts keeps imports + construction sites; both files are in tsconfig include and package.json files. Registered /vibeguard:list and /vibeguard:stats (ctx.ui.custom only, zero session writes; command layer reuses the engine's own cleanup before snapshotting); (4) tests/ added (vitest unit + extension-level integration); tsconfig include widened (tests, allowImportingTsExtensions; test-engine.ts deliberately excluded from typecheck since 2026-09-19 — upstream standalone script with zero runtime references) and eslint ignores test-engine.ts (must stay: typed linting requires tsconfig membership) and eslint ignores test-engine.ts (upstream standalone script); (5) README fork notice + CHANGELOG 0.1.0 fork entry. (6) 0.2.0 session suspension: SuspensionState class in index.ts (~:258-320), suspension skip-params threaded through redactText/redactDeep/redactMessageContent and the restore path, /vibeguard:disable|enable|status|categories commands. 2026-09-19 P2 pass: the suspension skip-threading through redactText/redactDeep/redactMessageContent was replaced by a call-site PatternSet filter (fork-only suspension-filter.ts, filterPatternSet, applied once at the context handler entry); the three engine functions are byte-identical to upstream again (restore path untouched, single call site verified).
